params.body:
Third step for `deployed`. One round after abovebeyond-ai/elixir#170 every measured row carries Elixir's verdict (seven projects ok, naviskore staging month, all `source: elixir` in the brief), so the card's own rule goes: the 7 and 2 days in PHP are deleted. A row without a verdict (a stale one from before) shows background with "not yet", never ok and never now, because a level made up on a screen is the drift this removes. The launch-list fixture carries a verdict now, as the real staging rows do. Architecture paper updated.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: The Deployed card holds no number: Elixir's verdict or not judged yet
